messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync — capturing postmortem follow-ups for the streaming/chat instability (timeouts, partials, reconnects). want clear owners + short ETAs so we can close the ticket this quarter. here's a compact plan.

Maya Patel: plan (high level): 1) add richer telemetry at gateway + downstream to map partials to client builds; 2) persist ack checkpoints at gateway so resume is durable; 3) SDK resume protocol with dedupe token + conservative backoff; 4) evaluate adaptive idle timeouts and per-route backpressure signals; 5) guarded canary rollout with automatic rollback; 6) long soak with chaotic disconnects and token-level trace sampling.

Olivia Chen: I'll take telemetry. proposal: add tags `stream_seq`, `client_build`, and `resume_token` to spans; emit a lightweight event to Kafka topic `streaming-partials-v3` with 14d retention. will post Avro schema & example queries. owner: Olivia. ETA: 2026-04-01.

Jun Park: gateway durability: I'll prototype a tiny durable-ack store (rocksdb local + async replicate) so an ack is persisted before we ack the client. this avoids replaying tokens on reconnect. owner: Jun. ETA: 2026-04-06 for prototype, 2026-04-15 for rollout behind feature flag.

Tariq Ahmed: SDK work: implement resume handshake that sends last-received-token and a new header `X-Resume-Token`. SDK will generate a `delta_id` per chunk and server will drop duplicates. also adding jittered backoff (base 1.5s, cap 10s) and a soft reconnect window to avoid thundering herd. owner: Tariq. ETA: SDK PR by 2026-03-29, release 0.12.4 on 2026-04-02.

Anil Rao: infra guardrails: create a canary route that sends 3% traffic to the small-batch path and wire an automated rollback if `partial_rate` > 1.0% sustained for 5m or `resume_fail_rate` > 0.5% for 3m. also add RBAC so Dedicated customers can opt out of the canary. owner: Anil. ETA: 2026-03-28.

Maya Patel: timeout/backpressure: Jun + infra to propose adaptive idle timeout rules: for sessions > 90s, increase idle threshold from 12s to 30s; tighten queue-shed for spikes. include HPA rule: scale workers when avg queued-requests/worker > 8.

Jun Park: noted. I'll run A/B load tests: baseline vs adaptive idle policy, and collect P95/P99 token latency and concurrent worker counts. test window: 2026-03-31 -> 2026-04-02.

Olivia Chen: observability: I'll add Grafana panels: `partial_rate`, `resume_success_rate`, `avg_resume_latency`, `kafka_consumer_lag(streaming-partials-v3)`. will add an alert runbook link.

Tariq Ahmed: integration tests: SDK + gateway e2e tests to simulate flaky network: reconnects, dup chunks, delayed acks. will add unit tests for `delta_id` dedupe logic and a QA job that runs during soak.

Maya Patel: soak: cross-team 96h soak with chaotic disconnect pattern (random 5-25% drop, inter-arrival jitter). soak window: 2026-04-03 00:00Z -> 2026-04-07 00:00Z. acceptance criteria: partial_rate < 0.25%, resume_success_rate > 99.5%, no token dupes observed in sampled traces. owner: cross-team.

Anil Rao: CI/rollout gating: will add a preflight job that runs the e2e reconnect tests and prevents canary if failures > 0. Also adding automatic rollback into the deployment pipeline.

Olivia Chen: data retention note: streaming-partials-v3 will keep raw events 14d, but we will aggregate daily metrics for 90d. I'll publish the retention and schema by ETA.

Jun Park: risk: durable-ack persistence increases gateway write IOPS. mitigation: local write + async replicate to s3-backed blob store during canary, monitor write latency and fail open if persistence slows below threshold. will document thresholds.

Tariq Ahmed: product note: the resume-handshake changes the client-server contract slightly. product okayed a minor SDK bump for non-breaking change. will include migration notes in release.

Maya Patel: condensed action list for the ticket (owner -> ETA):
- telemetry + kafka topic `streaming-partials-v3` (Olivia) -> 2026-04-01
- durable ack prototype + feature flag (Jun) -> proto 2026-04-06, rollout 2026-04-15
- SDK resume + delta_id + X-Resume-Token header (Tariq) -> PR 2026-03-29, release 2026-04-02
- adaptive idle timeout tests + HPA rule (Jun/Anil) -> test window 2026-03-31-2026-04-02
- canary + rollback automation (Anil) -> 2026-03-28
- 96h chaotic soak (cross-team) -> 2026-04-03 - 2026-04-07
- Grafana panels + alerts (Olivia) -> 2026-03-30

Maya Patel: please ack ownership and call out any blockers. I'll add this list to the postmortem ticket and request weekly status pings until closed.

Olivia Chen: acked. will post schema and dashboard links when ready.

Tariq Ahmed: acked. opening SDK PR now and tagging reviewers.

Jun Park: acked. starting load-test infra work tomorrow.

Anil Rao: acked. will slot the canary pipeline and CI gate.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: small-batch kernel rollout 2026-03-28T04:00:00Z (3% traffic). Rollback triggers: `partial_rate` > 1.0% for 5m OR `resume_fail_rate` > 0.5% for 3m -> automatic rollback.

Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll set up recurring 30min weekly check-ins on Tuesdays until all items are closed. ping #eng-sre for urgent blockers. :white_check_mark:
